### Section 2 — Create `commission_split_tax_line_record` RPC

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(
  p_parent_split_id uuid,
  p_tax_line_id     text,
  p_jurisdiction    text,
  p_tax_amount_cents bigint
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_existing RECORD;
  v_parent RECORD;
  v_new_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_tax_amount_cents < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_record: tax_amount_cents must be >= 0';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency check via UNIQUE (parent_split_id, tax_line_id) WHERE kind='tax_line'
  SELECT id INTO v_existing
    FROM commission_splits
    WHERE parent_split_id = p_parent_split_id
      AND tax_line_id = p_tax_line_id
      AND kind = 'tax_line';

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_existing.id, 'created', false);
  END IF;

  -- Validate parent exists + is a regular split (not another tax_line)
  SELECT id, studio_id, booking_id, session_id, artist_id, kind INTO v_parent
    FROM commission_splits
    WHERE id = p_parent_split_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_record: parent split % not found', p_parent_split_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_parent.kind = 'tax_line' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_record: parent must be a regular split, not tax_line';
  END IF;

  -- Insert tax_line row
  INSERT INTO commission_splits (
    studio_id, booking_id, session_id, artist_id,
    base_amount_cents, commission_pct, tip_amount_cents,
    applied_from_pool_cents, stripe_transfer_id,
    kind, parent_split_id,
    tax_amount_cents, tax_line_id, jurisdiction
  ) VALUES (
    v_parent.studio_id, v_parent.booking_id, v_parent.session_id, v_parent.artist_id,
    0, 0, 0, 0, NULL,
    'tax_line', p_parent_split_id,
    p_tax_amount_cents, p_tax_line_id, p_jurisdiction
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_new_id, 'created', true);
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(uuid, text, text, bigint) IS
  'S17. Idempotent insert of tax-line attribution row. UNIQUE on (parent_split_id, tax_line_id) WHERE kind=tax_line.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(uuid, text, text, bigint) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(uuid, text, text, bigint) TO service_role;
```

### Section 3 — Create `commission_splits_drift_check` RPC

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(p_since_timestamp timestamptz)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_pis_missing jsonb;
  v_disputes_missing jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- PIs that succeeded but have no commission_splits row of kind='split'
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
    'charge_id', sc.charge_id,
    'studio_id', sc.studio_id,
    'created_at', sc.created_at
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_pis_missing
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
    ON cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id AND cs.kind = 'split'
  WHERE sc.status = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND cs.id IS NULL
    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL;

  -- Disputes lost without a corresponding kind='reversal' commission_splits row
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'dispute_id', sd.dispute_id,
    'charge_id', sd.charge_id,
    'studio_id', sd.studio_id,
    'resolved_at', sd.resolved_at
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_disputes_missing
  FROM stripe_disputes sd
  WHERE sd.status = 'lost'
    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM commission_splits cs
      WHERE cs.kind = 'reversal'
        AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
        AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
        AND cs.studio_id = sd.studio_id
        -- Heuristic: dispute's charge maps to a booking via stripe_charges
        AND cs.booking_id IN (
          SELECT booking_id FROM stripe_charges WHERE charge_id = sd.charge_id LIMIT 1
        )
    );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'pis_missing_split', v_pis_missing,
    'disputes_missing_reversal', v_disputes_missing
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) IS
  'S17. Read-only drift detector for reconciliation cron. Returns PIs missing commission_splits + lost disputes missing reversal.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) TO service_role;
```

### Section 4 — Extend `commission_split_record` to accept tax fields

Replace the existing function (CREATE OR REPLACE) with extended signature. Add 3 optional params at the END (so old callers still work — Postgres function overloading by arg list).

Actually Postgres doesn't do JS-style optional args — every CALL must pass all args. To preserve backward compat, EITHER (a) add a NEW function `commission_split_record_v2(...)` with extended args, OR (b) replace the existing function with the new signature and update all callers. Option (b) is cleaner since contracts.ts is the source of truth.

Use approach (b) — extend the existing function. Old callers (S13 webhook handler in `lib/payments/process-stripe-event.ts` + S16 charge route) need to pass NULL/0 for new fields. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_split_record(
```sql
  p_studio_id              uuid,
  p_booking_id             uuid,
  p_session_id             uuid,

  p_base_amount_cents      bigint,

  p_tax_line_id            text    DEFAULT NULL,
  p_jurisdiction           text    DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO commission_splits (
    studio_id, booking_id, session_id, artist_id,
    base_amount_cents, commission_pct, tip_amount_cents,
    applied_from_pool_cents, stripe_transfer_id,

    p_applied_from_pool_cents, p_stripe_transfer_id,
    p_kind, p_tax_amount_cents, p_tax_line_id, p_jurisdiction
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_id);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_split_record(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, bigint, numeric, bigint, bigint, text, text, bigint, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_record(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, bigint, numeric, bigint, bigint, text, text, bigint, text, text) TO service_role;
```

Postgres named-parameter calls (which contracts.ts uses via `supabase.rpc(...)`) work transparently with DEFAULTs — old callers don't need to pass the new params.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook(
  p_payment_intent_id     text,
  p_status                text,
  p_charge_id             text,
  p_transfer_id           text,
  p_application_fee_id    text,
  p_tax_amount_cents      bigint DEFAULT NULL    -- S17: optional tax mirror
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER

  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'status', v_status);
END;
$$;
```

178	-- SECTION 3 — RPC: apply_deposit_to_session
179	--
180	-- Spec: ApplyDepositToSessionArgs / ApplyDepositToSessionResult (contracts.ts)
181	-- Params: p_project_id, p_session_id, p_draw_cents, p_idempotency_key
182	-- Returns: jsonb { transaction_id, pool_in_cents, pool_applied_cents, pool_available_cents }
183	-- Grant: service_role ONLY
184	-- =============================================================================
185	
186	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_deposit_to_session(
187	  p_project_id        uuid,
188	  p_session_id        uuid,
189	  p_draw_cents        bigint,
190	  p_idempotency_key   text
191	)
192	RETURNS jsonb
193	LANGUAGE plpgsql
194	VOLATILE
195	SECURITY DEFINER
196	SET search_path = public
197	AS $$
198	DECLARE
199	  v_existing_txn  RECORD;
200	  v_project       RECORD;
201	  v_new_txn_id    uuid;
202	BEGIN
203	  -- ── Validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
204	  IF p_draw_cents IS NULL OR p_draw_cents <= 0 THEN
205	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'apply_deposit_to_session: draw_cents must be > 0, got %', p_draw_cents;
206	  END IF;
207	
208	  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) = 0 THEN
209	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'apply_deposit_to_session: idempotency_key must not be null or empty';
210	  END IF;
211	
212	  -- ── Idempotency check via UNIQUE idempotency_key ──────────────────────────
213	  SELECT id, project_id, draw_cents, status
214	    INTO v_existing_txn
215	    FROM project_deposit_transactions
216	   WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
217	
218	  IF FOUND THEN
219	    -- Already applied — return same result (idempotent retry)
220	    SELECT deposit_pool_cents,
221	           deposit_applied_cents
222	      INTO v_project
223	      FROM projects
224	     WHERE id = v_existing_txn.project_id;
225	
226	    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
227	      'transaction_id',       v_existing_txn.id,
228	      'pool_in_cents',        v_project.deposit_pool_cents,
229	      'pool_applied_cents',   v_project.deposit_applied_cents,
230	      'pool_available_cents', v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents
231	    );
232	  END IF;
233	
234	  -- ── Lock project row for update (prevents double-draw races) ─────────────
235	  SELECT id,
236	         deposit_pool_cents,
237	         deposit_applied_cents
238	    INTO v_project
239	    FROM projects
240	   WHERE id = p_project_id
241	     FOR UPDATE;
242	
243	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
244	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'apply_deposit_to_session: project % not found', p_project_id;
245	  END IF;
246	
247	  -- ── Verify sufficient pool balance ───────────────────────────────────────
248	  --    available = deposit_pool_cents - deposit_applied_cents
249	  IF (v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents) < p_draw_cents THEN
250	    RAISE EXCEPTION
251	      'apply_deposit_to_session: insufficient pool — available % cents < draw % cents',
252	      (v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents),
253	      p_draw_cents;
254	  END IF;
255	
256	  -- ── Decrement available by incrementing applied (direct UPDATE, not trigger) ──
257	  --    We bypass the INSERT trigger by inserting type='saga_hold'; the trigger's
258	  --    IF chain ignores that value, so we own the counter update here.
259	  UPDATE projects
260	     SET deposit_applied_cents = deposit_applied_cents + p_draw_cents
261	   WHERE id = p_project_id
262	   RETURNING deposit_pool_cents, deposit_applied_cents
263	    INTO v_project;
264	
265	  -- ── Insert pending_apply SAGA row ─────────────────────────────────────────
266	  INSERT INTO project_deposit_transactions (
267	    project_id,
268	    type,
269	    kind,
270	    amount_cents,
271	    draw_cents,
272	    applied_to_session_id,
273	    session_id,
274	    status,
275	    idempotency_key
276	  ) VALUES (
277	    p_project_id,
278	    'saga_hold',            -- type: not counted by existing trigger
279	    'split',                -- SAGA kind per CommissionSplitKind
280	    p_draw_cents,           -- amount_cents mirrors draw_cents for SAGA rows
281	    p_draw_cents,
282	    p_session_id,           -- existing FK column (applied_to_session_id)
283	    p_session_id,           -- new SAGA session_id column
284	    'pending_apply',
285	    p_idempotency_key
286	  )
287	  RETURNING id INTO v_new_txn_id;
288	
289	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
290	    'transaction_id',       v_new_txn_id,
291	    'pool_in_cents',        v_project.deposit_pool_cents,
292	    'pool_applied_cents',   v_project.deposit_applied_cents,
293	    'pool_available_cents', v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents
294	  );
295	END;
296	$$;
297	
298	COMMENT ON FUNCTION apply_deposit_to_session(uuid, uuid, bigint, text) IS
299	  'S16 SAGA step 1. SELECT FOR UPDATE on project row, verify pool balance, '
300	  'increment deposit_applied_cents, insert pending_apply SAGA row. '
301	  'Idempotent on idempotency_key. Call BEFORE stripe.paymentIntents.create(). '
302	  'Pass returned transaction_id in PI metadata. Webhook calls confirm or rollback.';
303	
304	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION apply_deposit_to_session(uuid, uuid, bigint, text) FROM PUBLIC;
305	GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION apply_deposit_to_session(uuid, uuid, bigint, text) TO service_role;

308	-- SECTION 4 — RPC: confirm_deposit_application
309	--
310	-- Spec: ConfirmDepositApplicationArgs / ConfirmDepositApplicationResult (contracts.ts)
311	-- Params: p_transaction_id, p_payment_intent_id
312	-- Returns: jsonb { transaction_id, status }
313	-- Grant: service_role ONLY
314	-- =============================================================================
315	
316	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION confirm_deposit_application(
317	  p_transaction_id    uuid,
318	  p_payment_intent_id text
319	)
320	RETURNS jsonb
321	LANGUAGE plpgsql
322	VOLATILE
323	SECURITY DEFINER
324	SET search_path = public
325	AS $$
326	DECLARE
327	  v_txn RECORD;
328	BEGIN
329	  -- ── Lock and load transaction row ─────────────────────────────────────────
330	  SELECT id, status, project_id
331	    INTO v_txn
332	    FROM project_deposit_transactions
333	   WHERE id = p_transaction_id
334	     FOR UPDATE;
335	
336	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
337	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'confirm_deposit_application: transaction % not found', p_transaction_id;
338	  END IF;
339	
340	  -- ── Idempotent: already confirmed → no-op ────────────────────────────────
341	  IF v_txn.status = 'applied' THEN
342	    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
343	      'transaction_id', p_transaction_id,
344	      'status',         'already_applied'
345	    );
346	  END IF;
347	
348	  -- ── Guard: cannot confirm a non-pending row ───────────────────────────────
349	  IF v_txn.status <> 'pending_apply' THEN
350	    RAISE EXCEPTION
351	      'confirm_deposit_application: transaction % is in status % — cannot confirm (must be pending_apply)',
352	      p_transaction_id,
353	      v_txn.status;
354	  END IF;
355	
356	  -- ── Flip pending_apply → applied ──────────────────────────────────────────
357	  UPDATE project_deposit_transactions
358	     SET status            = 'applied',
359	         confirmed_at      = now(),
360	         payment_intent_id = p_payment_intent_id
361	   WHERE id = p_transaction_id;
362	
363	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
364	    'transaction_id', p_transaction_id,
365	    'status',         'applied'
366	  );
367	END;
368	$$;
369	
370	COMMENT ON FUNCTION confirm_deposit_application(uuid, text) IS
371	  'S16 SAGA step 2 — success path. Called by webhook on payment_intent.succeeded. '
372	  'Flips pending_apply → applied, records payment_intent_id. Idempotent.';
373	
374	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION confirm_deposit_application(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC;
375	GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION confirm_deposit_application(uuid, text) TO service_role;

377	-- =============================================================================
378	-- SECTION 5 — RPC: rollback_deposit_application
379	--
380	-- Spec: RollbackDepositApplicationArgs / RollbackDepositApplicationResult (contracts.ts)
381	-- Params: p_transaction_id, p_reason
382	-- Returns: jsonb { transaction_id, status, pool_available_cents }
383	-- Grant: service_role ONLY
384	-- =============================================================================
385	
386	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rollback_deposit_application(
387	  p_transaction_id uuid,
388	  p_reason         text
389	)
390	RETURNS jsonb
391	LANGUAGE plpgsql
392	VOLATILE
393	SECURITY DEFINER
394	SET search_path = public
395	AS $$
396	DECLARE
397	  v_txn     RECORD;
398	  v_project RECORD;
399	BEGIN
400	  -- ── Validate reason ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
401	  IF p_reason NOT IN ('payment_failed', 'payment_canceled', 'reaper_timeout', 'manual') THEN
402	    RAISE EXCEPTION
403	      'rollback_deposit_application: invalid reason ''%'' — must be one of: payment_failed, payment_canceled, reaper_timeout, manual',
404	      p_reason;
405	  END IF;
406	
407	  -- ── Lock and load transaction row ─────────────────────────────────────────
408	  SELECT id, status, project_id, draw_cents
409	    INTO v_txn
410	    FROM project_deposit_transactions
411	   WHERE id = p_transaction_id
412	     FOR UPDATE;
413	
414	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
415	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollback_deposit_application: transaction % not found', p_transaction_id;
416	  END IF;
417	
418	  -- ── Idempotent: already rolled back → no-op, return current pool state ────
419	  IF v_txn.status = 'rolled_back' THEN
420	    SELECT deposit_pool_cents, deposit_applied_cents
421	      INTO v_project
422	      FROM projects
423	     WHERE id = v_txn.project_id;
424	
425	    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
426	      'transaction_id',       p_transaction_id,
427	      'status',               'already_rolled_back',
428	      'pool_available_cents', v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents
429	    );
430	  END IF;
431	
432	  -- ── Guard: only pending_apply can be rolled back ──────────────────────────
433	  --    Applied or released rows require the refund flow (release_deposit_from_session).
434	  IF v_txn.status <> 'pending_apply' THEN
435	    RAISE EXCEPTION
436	      'rollback_deposit_application: transaction % is in status % — '
437	      'cannot rollback (use release_deposit_from_session for applied/released rows)',
438	      p_transaction_id,
439	      v_txn.status;
440	  END IF;
441	
442	  -- ── Re-credit pool: decrement applied (return the held amount) ────────────
443	  --    Lock project row AFTER we already have the txn lock (consistent ordering).
444	  UPDATE projects
445	     SET deposit_applied_cents = deposit_applied_cents - v_txn.draw_cents
446	   WHERE id = v_txn.project_id
447	   RETURNING deposit_pool_cents, deposit_applied_cents
448	    INTO v_project;
449	
450	  -- Guard: applied_cents should never go negative
451	  IF v_project.deposit_applied_cents < 0 THEN
452	    RAISE EXCEPTION
453	      'rollback_deposit_application: deposit_applied_cents would go negative for project % — data integrity error',
454	      v_txn.project_id;
455	  END IF;
456	
457	  -- ── Flip pending_apply → rolled_back ─────────────────────────────────────
458	  UPDATE project_deposit_transactions
459	     SET status              = 'rolled_back',
460	         rolled_back_at      = now(),
461	         rolled_back_reason  = p_reason
462	   WHERE id = p_transaction_id;
463	
464	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
465	    'transaction_id',       p_transaction_id,
466	    'status',               'rolled_back',
467	    'pool_available_cents', v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents
468	  );
469	END;
470	$$;
471	
472	COMMENT ON FUNCTION rollback_deposit_application(uuid, text) IS
473	  'S16 SAGA step 2 — failure path. Called by webhook on payment_intent.payment_failed | canceled, '
474	  'or by reaper cron after 30-min timeout. Re-credits deposit_applied_cents. '
475	  'Only valid on pending_apply rows. Idempotent.';
476	
477	REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION rollback_deposit_application(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC;
478	GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION rollback_deposit_application(uuid, text) TO service_role;

481	-- SECTION 6 — RPC: release_deposit_from_session
482	--
483	-- Spec: ReleaseDepositFromSessionArgs / ReleaseDepositFromSessionResult (contracts.ts)
484	-- Params: p_transaction_id, p_release_cents, p_idempotency_key, p_refund_id
485	-- Returns: jsonb { release_transaction_id, pool_available_cents, total_released_cents }
486	-- Grant: service_role ONLY
487	-- =============================================================================
488	
489	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION release_deposit_from_session(
490	  p_transaction_id  uuid,
491	  p_release_cents   bigint,
492	  p_idempotency_key text,
493	  p_refund_id       text
494	)
495	RETURNS jsonb
496	LANGUAGE plpgsql
497	VOLATILE
498	SECURITY DEFINER
499	SET search_path = public
500	AS $$
501	DECLARE
502	  v_existing_release  RECORD;
503	  v_parent_txn        RECORD;
504	  v_total_released    bigint;
505	  v_project           RECORD;
506	  v_new_release_id    uuid;
507	BEGIN
508	  -- ── Validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
509	  IF p_release_cents IS NULL OR p_release_cents <= 0 THEN
510	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_deposit_from_session: release_cents must be > 0, got %', p_release_cents;
511	  END IF;
512	
513	  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) = 0 THEN
514	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_deposit_from_session: idempotency_key must not be null or empty';
515	  END IF;
516	
517	  -- ── Idempotency check: has this release already been processed? ───────────
518	  SELECT id, project_id, parent_transaction_id, draw_cents
519	    INTO v_existing_release
520	    FROM project_deposit_transactions
521	   WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
522	     AND status = 'released';
523	
524	  IF FOUND THEN
525	    -- Compute running total released for this parent and return
526	    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(draw_cents), 0)
527	      INTO v_total_released
528	      FROM project_deposit_transactions
529	     WHERE parent_transaction_id = v_existing_release.parent_transaction_id
530	       AND status = 'released';
531	
532	    SELECT deposit_pool_cents, deposit_applied_cents
533	      INTO v_project
534	      FROM projects
535	     WHERE id = v_existing_release.project_id;
536	
537	    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
538	      'release_transaction_id', v_existing_release.id,
539	      'pool_available_cents',   v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents,
540	      'total_released_cents',   v_total_released
541	    );
542	  END IF;
543	
544	  -- ── Lock parent transaction row ────────────────────────────────────────────
545	  SELECT id, project_id, status, draw_cents, session_id, applied_to_session_id
546	    INTO v_parent_txn
547	    FROM project_deposit_transactions
548	   WHERE id = p_transaction_id
549	     FOR UPDATE;
550	
551	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
552	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_deposit_from_session: parent transaction % not found', p_transaction_id;
553	  END IF;
554	
555	  -- ── Guard: parent must be applied ─────────────────────────────────────────
556	  IF v_parent_txn.status <> 'applied' THEN
557	    RAISE EXCEPTION
558	      'release_deposit_from_session: parent transaction % is in status % — must be applied to release',
559	      p_transaction_id,
560	      v_parent_txn.status;
561	  END IF;
562	
563	  -- ── Compute already-released amount against this parent ───────────────────
564	  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(draw_cents), 0)
565	    INTO v_total_released
566	    FROM project_deposit_transactions
567	   WHERE parent_transaction_id = p_transaction_id
568	     AND status = 'released';
569	
570	  -- ── Bounds check: cannot release more than original draw (less already released) ──
571	  IF v_total_released + p_release_cents > v_parent_txn.draw_cents THEN
572	    RAISE EXCEPTION
573	      'release_deposit_from_session: release would exceed remaining — '
574	      'already_released=%, requested=%, parent_draw_cents=%',
575	      v_total_released,
576	      p_release_cents,
577	      v_parent_txn.draw_cents;
578	  END IF;
579	
580	  -- ── Lock project row and re-credit pool ───────────────────────────────────
581	  UPDATE projects
582	     SET deposit_applied_cents = deposit_applied_cents - p_release_cents
583	   WHERE id = v_parent_txn.project_id
584	   RETURNING deposit_pool_cents, deposit_applied_cents
585	    INTO v_project;
586	
587	  -- Guard: applied_cents should never go negative
588	  IF v_project.deposit_applied_cents < 0 THEN
589	    RAISE EXCEPTION
590	      'release_deposit_from_session: deposit_applied_cents would go negative for project % — data integrity error',
591	      v_parent_txn.project_id;
592	  END IF;
593	
594	  -- ── Insert release child row ──────────────────────────────────────────────
595	  INSERT INTO project_deposit_transactions (
596	    project_id,
597	    type,
598	    kind,
599	    amount_cents,
600	    draw_cents,
601	    applied_to_session_id,
602	    session_id,
603	    status,
604	    idempotency_key,
605	    parent_transaction_id,
606	    payment_intent_id       -- store refund_id in payment_intent_id for cross-reference
607	  ) VALUES (
608	    v_parent_txn.project_id,
609	    'saga_hold',            -- type: not counted by existing trigger
610	    'released',             -- SAGA kind: this is a pool release (refund re-credit)
611	    p_release_cents,        -- amount_cents mirrors draw_cents
612	    p_release_cents,
613	    v_parent_txn.applied_to_session_id,
614	    v_parent_txn.session_id,
615	    'released',
616	    p_idempotency_key,
617	    p_transaction_id,
618	    p_refund_id
619	  )
620	  RETURNING id INTO v_new_release_id;
621	
622	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
623	    'release_transaction_id', v_new_release_id,
624	    'pool_available_cents',   v_project.deposit_pool_cents - v_project.deposit_applied_cents,
625	    'total_released_cents',   v_total_released + p_release_cents
626	  );
627	END;
628	$$;
629	
630	COMMENT ON FUNCTION release_deposit_from_session(uuid, bigint, text, text) IS
631	  'S16 SAGA refund path. Re-credits deposit pool for a previously-applied drawdown. '
632	  'Partial releases supported (release_cents <= parent draw_cents - already_released). '
633	  'Idempotent on idempotency_key. Called from refund flow on charge.refunded webhook.';
634

    p_tax_line_id,
    p_jurisdiction
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_new_id, 'created', true);
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(uuid, text, text, bigint) IS
  'S17. Idempotent insert of a tax-line attribution row (kind=tax_line). '
  'One row per (parent_split_id, tax_line_id) per jurisdiction. '
  'Caller iterates Stripe charge.amount_details.tax_breakdown[] after recording '
  'the parent split and inserts one child per breakdown entry. '
  'Webhook-replay safe via UNIQUE partial index uniq_commission_splits_tax_line.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(uuid, text, text, bigint) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_record(uuid, text, text, bigint) TO service_role;

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 5 — New RPC: commission_splits_drift_check
--
-- Spec : CommissionSplitsDriftCheckArgs → CommissionSplitsDriftCheckResult
-- Name : RPC.COMMISSION_SPLITS_DRIFT_CHECK = 'commission_splits_drift_check'
-- Param: p_since_timestamp timestamptz
-- Returns: jsonb {
--   pis_missing_split: [{payment_intent_id, charge_id, studio_id, created_at}]
--   disputes_missing_reversal: [{dispute_id, charge_id, studio_id, resolved_at}]
-- }
-- Read-only: STABLE — cron reads, never writes
-- Grant: service_role ONLY
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(
  p_since_timestamp timestamptz
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_pis_missing         jsonb;
  v_disputes_missing    jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_since_timestamp IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_splits_drift_check: p_since_timestamp must not be null';
  END IF;

  -- ── Leg 1: Succeeded PIs that have no commission_splits row of kind='split' ──
  -- A succeeded stripe_charge with a booking_id MUST have generated a commission_splits
  -- row of kind='split'. Missing rows indicate the webhook handler failed after
  -- recording the charge but before recording the split.
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
        'created_at',        sc.created_at
      )
      ORDER BY sc.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_pis_missing
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
    ON  cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND cs.kind       = 'split'
  WHERE sc.status     = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.id         IS NULL;

  -- ── Leg 2: Lost disputes without a corresponding kind='reversal' row ─────────
  -- A dispute that closed 'lost' MUST trigger a commission split reversal.
  -- We use a heuristic time window (resolved_at ± 24h) to match reversals
  -- against disputes via the studio + booking join through stripe_charges.
  -- Cron should alert and trigger manual repair on any returned rows.
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'dispute_id',   sd.dispute_id,
        'charge_id',    sd.charge_id,
        'studio_id',    sd.studio_id,
        'resolved_at',  sd.resolved_at
      )
      ORDER BY sd.resolved_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_disputes_missing
  FROM stripe_disputes sd
  WHERE sd.status      = 'lost'
    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM commission_splits cs
       WHERE cs.kind       = 'reversal'
         AND cs.studio_id  = sd.studio_id
         AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
         AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
         AND cs.booking_id IN (
           SELECT sc_inner.booking_id
             FROM stripe_charges sc_inner
            WHERE sc_inner.charge_id  = sd.charge_id
              AND sc_inner.booking_id IS NOT NULL
            LIMIT 1
         )
    );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'pis_missing_split',        v_pis_missing,
    'disputes_missing_reversal', v_disputes_missing
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) IS
  'S17. Read-only drift detector for reconciliation cron. '
  'Returns two lists: (1) succeeded PaymentIntents missing their commission_splits '
  'kind=split row, (2) lost disputes missing a kind=reversal row. '
  'Caller (cron) logs + alerts; does NOT auto-repair. '
  'Call with p_since_timestamp = now() - interval ''24 hours'' for daily sweeps.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) TO service_role;

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 6 — Extend commission_split_record (10-arg → 13-arg with DEFAULT)
--
-- Spec : CommissionSplitRecordArgs → CommissionSplitRecordResult
-- Name : RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_RECORD = 'commission_split_record'
-- Backward compat:
--   S13/S16 callers that pass 10 positional args are unaffected — Postgres

--   Named-arg callers (supabase.rpc) that omit the new keys are unaffected.
--
-- DROP the old 10-arg overload before CREATE OR REPLACE to avoid Postgres
-- treating this as a new overload (different arg count = different signature).
-- =============================================================================

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS commission_split_record(
  uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, bigint, numeric, bigint, bigint, text, text
) CASCADE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_split_record(
  p_studio_id               uuid,
  p_booking_id              uuid,
  p_session_id              uuid,
  p_artist_id               uuid,
  p_base_amount_cents       bigint,
  p_commission_pct          numeric,
  p_tip_amount_cents        bigint,
  p_applied_from_pool_cents bigint,
  p_stripe_transfer_id      text,
  p_kind                    text,
  -- S17 extensions — optional with safe defaults so old callers are unaffected
  p_tax_amount_cents        bigint  DEFAULT 0,
  p_tax_line_id             text    DEFAULT NULL,
  p_jurisdiction            text    DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO commission_splits (
    studio_id,
    booking_id,
    session_id,
    artist_id,
    base_amount_cents,
    commission_pct,
    tip_amount_cents,
    applied_from_pool_cents,
    stripe_transfer_id,
    kind,
    tax_amount_cents,
    tax_line_id,
    jurisdiction
  ) VALUES (
    p_studio_id,
    p_booking_id,
    p_session_id,
    p_artist_id,
    p_base_amount_cents,
    p_commission_pct,
    p_tip_amount_cents,
    p_applied_from_pool_cents,
    p_stripe_transfer_id,
    p_kind,
    p_tax_amount_cents,
    p_tax_line_id,
    p_jurisdiction
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_id);
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_split_record(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, bigint, numeric, bigint, bigint, text, text, bigint, text, text) IS
  'L2 S13 → S17 extended. Append a commission split row with optional tax attribution. '
  'Audit trigger fires automatically on INSERT. '
  'Old 10-arg callers work via Postgres DEFAULT (tax_amount_cents=0, rest NULL). '
  'S17 callers pass taxAmountCents + taxLineId + jurisdiction for per-line attribution. '
  'parent_split_id is NULL for split/adjustment/tip kinds; use commission_split_reverse for reversals.';

GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_record(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, bigint, numeric, bigint, bigint, text, text, bigint, text, text) TO service_role;

-- SECTION 7 — Extend stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook (5-arg → 6-arg)
--
-- Spec : StripeChargeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs → StripeChargeUpdateStatusFromWebhookResult
-- Name : RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK = 'stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook'
-- S17 adds optional p_tax_amount_cents bigint DEFAULT NULL.
--   NULL = COALESCE no-op (preserves existing value).
--   Non-null = overwrite tax_amount_cents on the stripe_charges row.
-- Backward compat:
--   S13 5-arg callers work — DEFAULT NULL fills p_tax_amount_cents, COALESCE is a no-op.
--
-- DROP the old 5-arg overload before CREATE OR REPLACE (different arg count = new overload).
-- =============================================================================

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook(
  text, text, text, text, text
) CASCADE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook(
  p_payment_intent_id  text,
  p_status             text,
  p_charge_id          text,
  p_transfer_id        text,
  p_application_fee_id text,
  -- S17 extension — optional; NULL = no-op on existing tax_amount_cents value
  p_tax_amount_cents   bigint DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id     uuid;
  v_status text;
BEGIN
  UPDATE stripe_charges
     SET status             = p_status,
         charge_id          = COALESCE(p_charge_id,          charge_id),
         transfer_id        = COALESCE(p_transfer_id,        transfer_id),
         application_fee_id = COALESCE(p_application_fee_id, application_fee_id),
         -- NULL p_tax_amount_cents = caller did not supply it; preserve existing value.
         -- Non-null = explicit mirror from Stripe Tax on payment_intent.succeeded.
         tax_amount_cents   = COALESCE(p_tax_amount_cents,   tax_amount_cents)
   WHERE payment_intent_id = p_payment_intent_id
   RETURNING id, status INTO v_id, v_status;

  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook: no row found for payment_intent_id=%',
      p_payment_intent_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'status', v_status);
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook(text, text, text, text, text, bigint) IS
  'L2 S13 → S17 extended. Update stripe_charges on webhook events (succeeded, refunded, etc). '
  'S17: p_tax_amount_cents (optional, DEFAULT NULL) mirrors Stripe Tax amount when available. '
  'NULL = preserve existing value (COALESCE no-op). '
  'Old 5-arg callers work transparently via Postgres DEFAULT. '
  'Raises exception if payment_intent_id not found — caller must handle.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook(text, text, text, text, text, bigint) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook(text, text, text, text, text, bigint) TO service_role;
